claimText: Mary Had a Little Lamb (arranged for beginners): the familiar tune in F major, values doubled, with our own bass

checks.source: https://archive.org/details/childsownmusicbo00wier (The child's own music book, ed. A. E. Wier, New York: Mumil, 1918, p. 49)
checks.result: The printed melody (F major, 2/4, 8 bars) has the same pitches in the same order as the item; each item bar is one printed bar with the values doubled.
differences: bars 1 and 5: the printing's dotted "Ma-ry" (A dotted, G) is two even quarters
bar 8: the last F is held for the whole bar (the printing: a dotted quarter and a rest)

outcomeNote: Checked by eye 2026-09-24 against a 1918 public-domain printing of the familiar tune: pitches and order match in the same key; only the rhythm is made plain, as named in departures. No note changed.
